Dear Requester

The response to your subject access request is being issued under separate emails.   We will be issuing the response and any disclosed documents through Microsoft Encryption.

Instructions on how to open an encrypted email from HM Land Registry can be found on GOV.UK on the link below:

HM Land Registry email encryption - GOV.UK<https://www.gov.uk/guidance/hm-land-registry-email-encryption>

Yours sincerely


[logo]
S Henderson
Disclosure Officer, Information Rights Team

GOV.UK<https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations/land-registry> | @HMLandRegistry<https://twitter.com/HMLandRegistry> | LinkedIn<http://www.linkedin.com/company/land-registry> | Facebook<http://www.facebook.com/pages/Land-Registry/343223435769541>






HM Land Registry's purpose is to protect your land ownership and provide services and data that underpin an efficient and informed property market. Our vision is: "A world-leading property market as part of a thriving economy and a sustainable future".

We check all mail and attachments for known viruses. However, you are advised that you open any attachments at your own risk. If you have received this email and it was not intended for you, please let us know, then delete it.

We welcome correspondence in English and Welsh.

To see how HM Land Registry treats your personal information, read our Personal information charter: www.gov.uk/government/organisations/land-registry/about/personal-information-charter.

Your request for information has now been considered and our response is attached.

I trust that this information answers your request. Should you have any queries and wish to contact us by e-mail, please do so using the mail box [email redacted] .

South Wales Police provides you the right to request a re-examination of your case under its review procedure (copy attached).
